annotation.title_clean: Cambodia: Artificial Intelligence Readiness Assessment Report
annotation.title_en: Cambodia: Artificial Intelligence Readiness Assessment Report
annotation.authors_or_issuer: UNESCO; Cambodia Ministry of Post and Telecommunications
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: UNESCO landing page for the Cambodia AI Readiness Assessment Methodology report, completed July 2025 with the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications. It describes progress, challenges and recommendations to inform Cambodia's National AI Strategy, grounded in human rights, dignity and environmental well-being. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Cambodia's Ministry of Post and Telecommunications led the UNESCO AI Readiness Assessment Methodology, completed July 2025.
The report identifies challenges and offers practical recommendations.
Findings are intended to inform Cambodia's National AI Strategy.
Framed around human rights, human dignity and environmental well-being.
